detail.title: Execute the Episteme website interaction gate in a real browser
detail.description:
Purpose: replace the previously unexecuted real-browser gate with evidence on the current programming-language website while keeping the core and Ops independent of the DOM.

Acceptance criteria:

* All seven existing real-browser test bodies execute on the current source and pass; zero browser skips and zero prerequisite-only failures.
* Record browser engine/version, executable acquisition route, exact launch command, source/harness hashes, and complete gate output.
* Exercise the existing console, reference, documentation, and responsive interaction assertions; retain a reproducible diagnostic for any failed case.
* Re-run the relevant source/headless checks so the browser route does not hide a regression in no-window/no-DOM operation.
* Describe the verified behaviors narrowly; FKDB source inspection, static source checks, or ServeExcel's historical data-URL probe do not count as Episteme browser execution.

Starting evidence: evidence/integration/interface-browser-gate.txt; test/interface.test.cjs; scripts/run-browser.cjs. Current evidence is to be supplied by the browser owner before any Done transition.

Observed 2026-10-06: strict interface run passed 17/17 with all seven actual Chromium cases executed, zero failures/skips. Chromium 153.0.8010.0 was provisioned from @sparticuz/chromium 153.0.0 and driven by Playwright 1.62.1. Reproducible provisioner and final source reconciliation are being verified before the Done transition. Evidence: evidence/progression/browser-first-execution.log; browser-runtime-smoke.json; browser-desktop.png; browser-mobile.png; docs/progression/browser.md.

Completed 2026-10-06. Final exact-source gate: npm run test:browser = 17 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped, including all 7 actual Chromium bodies. Final npm test = 148 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped. Internal suites 155/155 and three no-window/no-DOM head/body/tail programs pass. The pinned provisioner reproduced acquisition/launch; the nonexistent-executable control fails strictly. Manual v6, RFC, README, website verification and session maintenance records agree with current evidence. Evidence: evidence/progression/current-browser.log; current-test-summary.json; browser-runtime.json; browser-strict-missing-binary.log; preservation.json; docs/progression/browser.md; docs/progression/report.md.
